title: Taskflow Agent finds unauthenticated domain creation in Lobsters
summary: The POST /domains create action lacked the moderator authentication check applied to edit and update, allowing unauthenticated users to create domain records and pollute or misrepresent moderation data.
ai_role: GHSL credits its Taskflow Agent and manual verification by Peter Stöckli and Man Yue Mo. Reported 2025-12-09; fixed on main branch 2025-12-22. The maintainer reported a collision with another report; priority/originality is therefore not exclusive. No CVE is listed.
classification_note: The advisory describes data pollution and possible moderation disruption; it does not claim exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: GHSL reports fixes on main branch in commits 9a29bba and 41d6d02 on 2025-12-22. No tagged release or CVE is given.
